issues.note: [aw] Detection Runs thread; machine-generated workflow telemetry, not a code defect. No action unless a maintainer asks.

checks.result: The self-hosted runner's mise-shim race (ETXTBSY, exit 126) is runner-side concurrency, not a branch problem. The repo-side retry for check.yml cannot ship as a PR: the App is refused write access to .github/workflows.
checks.follow_up: A verified one-step diff is in issue #2182. The maintainer closed #2182 on 2026-10-22 and check.yml is unchanged since #2094, so the retry was NOT applied - most likely the runner's job-concurrency was fixed instead. Do not re-raise; the durable fix is outside this repo.

checks.result: Audit of all thirteen admin index sorts against their table columns is COMPLETE. Found and fixed: created_at_asc mis-mapped on Articles+Comments (#2184, merged), the users revenue column/sort mismatch, and the collections sort vs 'Updated At' column. The other eleven indexes match their labels.
checks.follow_up: The admin invariant test (test/controllers/admin/order_by_test.rb) already pins allow-list == case branches == view options for every admin index - new sorts must be added in all three places.

checks.result: CHANGELOG.md had missed all 22 commits since release-2026-09-07. Synced on branch repo-assist/changelog-unreleased-sync (PR #2172, merged): mixin_bot 3.0 Blaze reactor, json ~>2.21 pin, #2105/#2107 crashes.
checks.follow_up: The changelog is now 12 commits behind again (the 11 merged PRs of 2026-10-22); a re-sync would be needed before a release.

checks.result: Integration sessions do NOT persist here: IntegrationTestCase#sign_in sets session[:current_session_id] but the cookie is never written, so the next request is anonymous.
checks.follow_up: So a test asserting 'redirects to root_path' can pass for the wrong reason (authenticate_user! redirects there too). Use ActionController::TestCase with @request.session, and add a happy-path 200 assertion.

checks.result: Stored XSS confirmed and fixed in draft PR #2176 (now merged): ActionText sanitizes only via ActionText::ContentHelper, but RichTextRenderService, MarkdownRenderService and RichTextContent#content_body read the raw fragment.
checks.follow_up: config/initializers/content_security_policy.rb is entirely commented out - a CSP header is a natural follow-up. The sanitizer drops inline style attributes and non-Turbo data-* attributes.

checks.result: NOT released. 34 commits unreleased since 2026-09-07, including eight Repo Assist fixes merged on 2026-10-22, a security fix, a major ransack bump and the deliberate json pin.
checks.follow_up: Never trigger Release: it deploys to production and needs maintainer approval. Flagged in the monthly issue instead.

checks.result: All seven Repo Assist PRs (#2181, #2184, #2178, #2176, #2172, #2171, #2169, #2163) were MERGED by the maintainer on 2026-10-22, and every issue they referenced was auto-closed. The only open PR is dependabot's #2185 (posthog-rails 3.19.2, Check green).
checks.follow_up: No open Repo Assist drafts to maintain; the new admin-sort draft is the only one.

checks.result: Full non-system suite: 1659 runs, 4706 assertions, 0 failures, 0 errors, 1 skip on the rack-attack branch (1662 runs on the admin-sort branch). The admin-sort regression test fails on the unpatched controller and passes after the fix.
checks.follow_up: Run via ruby -Itest glob loader, NOT `bin/rails test`: the rake path pulls test:prepare -> css:install and aborts without bun. Rack::Attack buckets per Time.now.to_i / period, so a fixed-request-count throttle test is a bucket-boundary flake.

checks.result: bin/rubocop 607 files no offenses; bin/rails zeitwerk:check all good; bin/lint-design-system 43 pre-existing DS010 warnings, none blocking, none introduced. safeoutputs update_issue allows only ONE call per run.
checks.follow_up: Spend that single update_issue on the monthly activity issue body, not on closing a duplicate - 2026-10-22 lost the body update that way. bun is NOT on PATH by default: export PATH="$HOME/.local/share/mise/shims:$PATH" before prettier or bun test.
